correctness.notes: Independently re-ran all math, not trusting the build reports. C (skill-health): record then report yields total 4 / rate 0.75 (3 success + 1 failure); 7d vs 30d windows differ correctly when a 10-day-old event is added (7d=0.75, 30d=0.80); declining flag fires (7d 0.50 + threshold 0.15 < 30d 0.83) and stays false when the recent rate holds; version drift reports stale (recorded 0.9.0 vs current 1.2.0) and ok (matching 2.0.0); empty and absent logs exit 0 with no-data and never crash; malformed JSONL lines are skipped. The scoring math is entirely in code (one deterministic python3 block) — no LLM, prompt, network, or eval (only the words 'eval'/'network' in comments). Confirmed unknown outcomes count toward total but are excluded from the success-rate denominator (1 success + 1 unknown -> total 2, rate_7d 1.00). D (scanner): planted AWS key, RSA/OPENSSH private keys, api_key long literal, and Authorization: Bearer all produce HIGH and --check exit 1; zero-width U+200B is HIGH; placeholders (YOUR_API_KEY_HERE, ${VAR}, <your-token-here>) are not flagged; composes_with [does-not-exist] -> MEDIUM, real name (orchestrator) -> none.

completeness.notes: Every contract-required deliverable present and exercised. C: scripts/skill-health.sh (report/record/drift/--help), hooks/scripts/skill-usage.sh + a manifest entry (profiles standard+strict, blocking:false), tests/skill-health/ (17 bats), additive 'Data source' notes in skill-review + skill-update. D: scripts/scan-skills.sh (--check/--text/--json), tests/scan-skills/ (15 bats), additive 'Automated pre-scan' note in security-agent; no .scan-skills-ignore needed (real tree is clean without one). Orchestrator wired the security-ubuntu CI job. QE added a 6-test adversarial scan file (tests/scan-skills/02-adversarial.bats). The only contract deviation is the meta-skill target substitution, addressed under contract_conformance.

code_quality.notes: bash -n clean on all three new scripts. Bash 3.2 portable throughout (tested on GNU bash 3.2.57 arm64-darwin): no mapfile/readarray, no associative arrays (only a comment mentions them); epoch math via python3 stdlib; mktemp temp files with trap cleanup. Tunable constants named (DECLINING_THRESHOLD, RECENT/TREND_WINDOW_DAYS). Tests are self-contained with mktemp temp dirs and pass --log / ATS_TELEMETRY_LOG so no test touches real ~/.claude/. Scanner redaction is centralized; secret rules redact runs of >=8 secret-ish chars keeping a 4-char prefix. The .scan-skills-ignore file-ignore test backs up and restores any real repo ignore file.

security.notes: Real-tree gate is genuinely green: scan-skills.sh --check skills/ exits 0 with 0 HIGH findings and NO ignore file. The 12 MEDIUM untrusted-composes were each verified to be genuinely EXTERNAL cross-plugin references (skill-creator, brainstorming, writing-plans, frontend-design, ui-ux-pro-max, ux-review, claude-api, feature-dev, loop, schedule) — none exist as in-repo skill dirs, so they are correct findings, not real broken refs and not false positives that should be silenced. The 13 LOW are all mcp-ref informational. No genuine secret/HIGH was missed by the build agent. Redaction verified across --json, --text, AND --check modes: a planted AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE never prints in full anywhere; a long sk- secret is redacted in the excerpt. Injection phrasing (ignore previous instructions / you are now / system prompt:) is MEDIUM-only and does NOT fail --check. No eval / network / shell-injection surface in any P2 script. The skill-usage hook is non-blocking, degrades silently, writes only to the telemetry log (temp during tests), and records outcome:unknown; it never created ~/.claude/ats-telemetry during QE.

contract_conformance.notes: Both contracts satisfied behaviorally. The one deviation: skill-health.md names skills/meta/skill-audit and skills/meta/skill-improvement-plan as the meta-skills to annotate, but NEITHER exists in the repo (meta/ contains skill-explorer, skill-review, skill-update, skill-writer). The agent correctly substituted skill-review (its description literally triggers on 'audit skills' and produces the quality report) and skill-update (plans+applies skill changes) — the functional successors. VERDICT: the substitution is SOUND and is the right call; freezing on the literal non-existent names would have been worse. The 'Data source' notes are additive, well-scoped, honest about the coarse/best-effort emitter and no-data semantics, and lint clean (0 errors). Scanner contract met including the blocking-CI-gate-green requirement and the redaction/ignore mechanisms. Ownership boundaries are clean: C touched none of D's files and vice-versa (verified by git status of the relevant paths). CI: security-ubuntu job parses via YAML safe_load, runs --check + bats; all four existing jobs (lint-ubuntu, hooks-ubuntu, installer-ubuntu, lint-macos) intact.
